headline: STL Networks appoints Gaurav Barjatiya as director
hook: STL Networks adds new board member
summary: STL Networks Limited announced the appointment of Mr Gaurav Barjatiya as a director effective October 16, 2026. The filing was made to the stock exchange as part of routine board changes. Existing shareholders and potential investors may watch for any strategic shifts resulting from the new appointment. The change is a standard corporate governance update with limited immediate market impact.
why_it_matters: Board change may influence company strategy
